exchanges: ok so you know how hockey season makes my family insane well its started and the group chat is already a war zone
Ha, hockey season group chats are a whole thing. Who's fighting with who?
so my mom is a die hard canucks fan like she has a jersey signed by someone from the 90s that she keeps in a frame and she texts every single goal in all caps
That's real dedication. The all-caps texts must be intense on game nights.
and then theres my husband ravi who doesnt care at all about hockey hes a paramedic and works nights half the time so he just wakes up to 400 messages
Waking up to that after a night shift sounds rough.
he mutes it now lol smart man
Probably the only way to survive.
and his mom is the complete opposite of my mom which is the problem, she grew up in edmonton and shes all about the oilers and they go at it every game
Two mothers on rival sides, that explains the war zone.
they actually love each other its just hockey
Friendly rivalry can be a good thing.
anyway thats not even why i messaged i need help with my daughter maya shes 7 and having a hard time at school this year
I'm sorry to hear that. What's been going on?
she has a new teacher ms abernathy and maya says shes strict and she comes home crying some days which breaks my heart
That's hard to see. Have you had a chance to meet the teacher yet?
not yet theres a parent night next week
That'd be a good chance to get a feel for her and ask how Maya's doing.
yeah i'll do that. maya's brother kai is fine at school thank god hes in grade 4 and loves it
Good that at least one of them is happy there.
only issue with kai is hes allergic to shellfish so every birthday party i have to call the parents first
That's a lot of extra work, but it's worth it for his safety.
its exhausting honestly
It sounds like it. You're doing a lot.
my grandpa lou says i worry too much but hes a retired farmer who thinks everything is fixed with fresh air
There's something to fresh air, but worrying about allergies is fair.
lol he drove his old tractor in the town parade last summer at 88
That's a fantastic image.
the whole town cheered
I bet.
ok so sorry i got the teacher wrong, i just looked at the school email, maya's teacher is ms okonkwo, ms abernathy is the other grade 2 class
Thanks for clarifying, good to have the right name before parent night.
would be embarrassing to call her the wrong name lol
Definitely better to go in knowing it.
so what should i ask at parent night
Ask how Maya seems in class, what a typical day looks like, and whether there's anything you can do at home to help.
ok good. and should i mention the crying
Yes, gently. The teacher may not know, and it helps her understand what Maya's feeling.
ok
You've got this. Teachers usually appreciate parents who reach out early.
thanks. its been a long day
Sounds like it. Anything nice planned for tonight?
maybe. our neighbour mr nguyen is having people over
That could be a nice way to unwind.
hes really fun hes like 70 and the life of the party
Sounds like a good neighbour to have.
he set up a whole karaoke machine in his garage and makes everyone sing at least once
That's a bold rule. Do you have a go-to song?
dancing queen obviously
A classic choice, impossible to go wrong.
ravi refuses to sing every time lol
Maybe tonight's the night he finally gives in.
